Class Octorok

java.lang.Object
entities.players.Players
entities.players.NonPlayable
entities.players.Octorok
public class Octorok extends NonPlayable
Class representing the "Octorok" non-playable character (NPC).

This NPC has ranged attack capabilities and moves according to an algorithm based on the target player's position. It inherits behavior from NonPlayable and overrides movement, attack, sprite loading, and drawing logic.
